verdict.rationale: The evidence only touches the story indirectly. 1Password lets users export their data (docs-15), and the SDKs and CLI "programmatically manage items" (docs-8, docs-2), which implies item deletion is possible but never states it. Nothing in the pack covers retention policies or account deletion. missing for 10: explicit item/vault deletion docs, account and data deletion process, configurable retention controls, server-side purge or backup retention details, independent corroboration.
